fact: The AI-based ScanForm system transcribing HIV testing registers reached 98% of 867 testing facilities by September 2024 and captured 9,082,891 encounters to September 2025, with the error rate falling from 1.6% to 0.4% over 24 months.
title: Digitising HIV Testing Registers to Support National Scale-Up of Three-Test HIV Diagnostic Algorithm: A Case Study of an AI-Powered Monitoring and Evaluation System in Malawi
